open.why: The document describes three 10 kΩ pots on A0-A2, three 220 Ω resistors on D3/D5/D6 and an RGB LED. circuit.json holds a breadboard, an Arduino Uno, ONE potentiometer, a vcc and a gnd: no resistor of any value, and no LED. The assert block passes because it asserts only the rail and that one pot's wiper, so the example is enrolled as `kind: full` with a green physics gate over a bench that cannot show what the page says. It is one of fourteen arduino-sk-* examples with a stubbed bench (p07 through p14 hold nothing but an Uno, a vcc and a gnd), which is why it is recorded here rather than repaired in this lane: building out fourteen starter-kit benches is its own piece of work, and doing one of them would leave the gate green over the other thirteen.
